description: Create a new price for a product.

allowOutOfStockPurchases.description: Whether to allow purchases when out of stock

amount.description: Price amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents)

compareAtPrice.description: Original / compare-at price for display purposes

membershipOffers.description: Array of membership offer objects tied to this price

productId.description: The product ID to create the price for

setupFee.description: One-time setup fee amount in the smallest currency unit

totalCycles.description: Total number of billing cycles (0 for unlimited)

trackInventory.description: Whether to track inventory for this price

trialPeriod.description: Trial period in days before billing starts

variantOptionIds.description: Array of variant option IDs associated with this price

name: crm_create_price
